# Publication checklist

- Native profile and sidecars preserve quoted descriptions, candidate state,
  license/role/visibility and explicit required-backend limits.
- All runtime Markdown resource links stay inside the graph. Declared related
  owner links use existing InferRSI metadata paths; those owners stay unchanged.
- Runtime content omits private environment paths, hostnames and credentials.
  Retained upstream copyright/attribution is deliberately public.
- Original license bytes, immutable source IDs and actual inspected spans are
  preserved; tree discovery is not mislabeled exhaustive semantic inspection.
- Concrete usability cases/reports stay under fixtures, outside runtime skill.
- Parent performs shared catalog/matrix/package integration, independent review
  and final PR/current-head provenance declaration. No managed import occurred.
- Eight required backend cases remain blocked; user-authorized repository
  contribution is not device qualification or managed-import eligibility.
